title: Capybara Merge: Tower Defense
shortDescription: Merge capybaras, evolve heroes, blast zombie hordes in one-hand tower defense!
fullDescription:
"Merge two capybaras. Get one bigger, angrier capybara. Point it at the zombies."

Capybara Merge: Tower Defense is a casual merge tower defense game where the calmest animals on earth finally lose their patience. Buy capybaras, merge them into stronger forms, line them up in front of your base, and watch the zombie hordes disappear under a wall of fire.

No complicated build orders. No twelve-tab upgrade screens. One thumb, one lane, one very tired capybara with a minigun.

Most defense games ask you to learn a map, pick a strategy and sit there for half an hour. This is the opposite: a casual tower defense game you can play with one thumb, an idle tower defense loop that keeps paying while you are away, and a zombie tower defense round that ends only when your line finally breaks. If you have ever searched for a capybara game and found nothing worth keeping, this is that game.

HOW TO PLAY
1. Buy a capybara — coins come from the zombies you drop.
2. Drag two of the same level together to merge them into the next tier. Same rules as any merge game you have played, except these ones shoot.
3. Place your front line to soak damage and your damage dealers behind it. Position decides who survives the wave.
4. Tap the Tactical Missile when the screen fills up. Timing is the skill.

WHY IT WORKS AS A TOWER DEFENSE GAME
Most merge games are a sorting puzzle with a score attached. This one puts the merge grid in front of the lane and makes the zombies come to you, so every merge is also a placement decision. Merging two tanks into one high-tier unit can leave your front line thin — that trade-off is the game. It is a merge defense game first and a cute showcase second, which is why the numbers matter as much as the outfits.

MERGE AND EVOLVE
Every tier changes more than the number on the card: new weapon, new fire pattern, new silhouette. Drag, merge, repeat. Then do it again with a better squad.

COSPLAY SKINS
Bat-Bara. Rainbow Unicorn. Caterpillar. Nobody asked for a capybara in a unicorn onesie, and yet here we are. Each form has its own shooting effect.

BUILT FOR SHORT SESSIONS
• One-hand portrait play — thumb on the bottom, game on top
• Offline: no wifi, no problem
• A run lasts as long as you want; endless mode keeps going while your line holds
• No energy bar gating your next round

COLLECT THEM ALL
An in-game encyclopedia tracks every capybara form you have unlocked. Completionists, this is your trap.

WHO THIS IS FOR
• Merge game players who want something to actually happen after the merge
• Tower defense fans who want a lighter, faster run than a 40-minute map
• Zombie game players who are tired of grim
• Anyone with ten minutes on a commute and one free hand

WHO IT IS NOT FOR
• Players who want deep tech trees and 30-minute build orders
• Players who dislike cute art
• Anyone looking for a story campaign — this is wave defense, not a narrative

FREE TO DOWNLOAD
The game is free, with optional ads and in-app purchases for extra coins. You can clear the early waves without spending anything.

Download Capybara Merge: Tower Defense and find out why the internet's most relaxed animal is the last line of defense.
